name: Enel
verdict: Italy's Ministry of Economy and Finance holds 23.6% of Enel; the rest is institutional and retail shareholders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: state ownership alone is not a tier. Italy has no sourced record of serious abuses in this dataset, so the 23.6% state ministry stake does not reach a rating (METHOD.md). Rated 'none' with the sourced ownership claim. Official partner of Mubadala Brazil and title partner of the Enel Rio Sail Grand Prix (SailGP team page and 2026 calendar).
